Personal Care and Daily Living Support

•	Understanding of person-centred care and the NDIS framework
•	Ability to follow care plans, behaviour support plans, and support strategies

•	Ability to work independently and as part of a team

We are seeking a quick commencement, working alongside other support workers with our clients, this team support role is based in Kippa Ring, Moreton Bay. You will need to bring your high level behavioural support skills, your critical thinking, risk management and negotiation skills along with your warm, engaged and fun-loving personality.

This role is not for the faint hearted. We work with multiple neurodiverse clients, many of whom are non-verbal and considered high risk. To do this we provide a unique model of support in a purpose built centre, with community access plans and home based supports as well. You need to be able to follow a group plan, contribute effectively to strategy reviews and hold your own when managing complex behaviours, while maintaining a neuro-affirming approach to support.

Qld WWC and NDIS Worker Screening check
Current police check
Drivers Licence, Car and comprehensive insurance
Minimum Certificate III level qualification in Individual Support, Disability, Education Support, Allied Health (OT, Speech, Physio), Early Childhood Education or a relevant field. Higher level tertiary qualifications will be highly valued and open different opportunities for promotion and development.
Current First Aid and CPR Qualifications

You will be happy and confident in your ability to get down to play and engage with children on the floor, and to support them while they climb and swim. You must be capable of promoting a healthy lifestyle to children, teenagers and adults in our care.

Hours vary, but you must be available after school and on Saturday’s during school terms, and on school holiday’s the more available you are the more hours you can have. This role is currently well suited to educators from special schools, teachers, allied health professionals, however we welcome anyone meeting the minimum requirements, skills, personal traits and availabilities to apply.

On offer is a fun-loving, considered risk-taking team who will help you get the best from your clients. We offer internal and external training opportunities, the use of company vehicles as needed, stable and reliable shifts for those who can do the work successfully. With regular team meetings and consultative management, an active EAP in place, we offer a supportive and dynamic work environment.

There is solid potential to grow your hours for the right fit for the clients and team. Pay is negotiable with qualifications and experience. This is an employment position, ABN holders need not apply.
